name: template-describe
description: Analyzes a MOGRT (video template) file and returns a manifest of editable controls; fonts, images, audio, video and other supported values.

type.description: Input template type. Use `mogrt` for a Motion Graphics Template or `aep` for an After Effects project. Defaults to `mogrt` when omitted.

url.description: A pre-signed URL pointing to the input template file. For `mogrt`, this is a `.mogrt` file. For `aep`, this is a `.zip` archive containing exactly one `.aep` project file together with its collected footage and assets.

source.description: Contains metadata about the source of the input template.

compName.description: Name of the After Effects composition to describe. Required when `type` is `aep`; not applicable to `mogrt`. This composition name within the AEP project must be unique so that `compName` resolves to a single composition.

name: get-presets
description: Returns a list of predefined social-first encoding presets for rendering outputs.

name: template-render
description: Renders one or more video variations by applying overrides and export presets. Submit up to 10 overrides per call for a subset of editable layers and get a pre-signed URL link to download the video file. For layers that are not editable, the system defaults are automatically applied at export.

type.description: Input template type. Use `mogrt` for a Motion Graphics Template or `aep` for an After Effects project. Defaults to `mogrt` when omitted.

url.description: A pre-signed URL pointing to the input template file. For `mogrt`, this is a `.mogrt` file. For `aep`, this is a `.zip` archive containing exactly one `.aep` project file together with its collected footage and assets.

source.description: Contains metadata about the source of the input template.

compName.description: Name of the After Effects composition to render. Required when `type` is `aep`; not applicable to `mogrt`. This composition name within the AEP project must be unique so that `compName` resolves to a single composition.

fonts.description: Array of fonts to be used in the template.

url.description: Pre-signed URL for the font file (.ttf/.otf).

config.description: Configuration options for the render request.

handleMissingFonts.description: How to handle missing fonts. 'fail' will cause the render to fail; 'use_default' will use Premiere Pro fallback behavior.

sidecar.description: Optional. Applicable only when `type` is `aep`. Set to `aep` to also produce the collected After Effects project (a self-contained archive of the `.aep` file and its footage), returned as `sidecarDestination` on each output. Not supported for `mogrt` renders.

assets.description: Array of image, video, or audio assets referenced by variations via assetIndex.

url.description: Pre-signed URL for the image, video, or audio asset.

presets.description: Array of export presets. Each item is either a built-in preset (by presetId) or a custom preset (by URL). Outputs reference presets by presetIndex.

presetId.description: ID of a built-in preset from the presets endpoint.

url.description: Pre-signed URL for a custom Encoder preset file.

variations.description: List of variations. Each variation contains variable overrides applied to the template.

variables.description: Variable overrides for this variation. Each object targets one template variable by variableId and supplies the override value.

variableId.description: Unique identifier for the template variable, taken verbatim from the describe response. For AEP, this is the composite ID of a control (for example `c259:l261:media` for a media control or `c169:l193:layer:sourceText` for a text control).

fontName.description: PostScript font name for text controls.

assetIndex.description: Index into the assets array for media or audio controls.

layerOperations.description: Layer-level timing operations applied after variable overrides, in array order. Applicable only when `type` is `aep`; ignored for `mogrt`. Each operation targets a layer by its `layerId` (the `layers[].id` value from the describe response, of the form `c{comp}:l{layer}:layer`). The exact field set depends on `operation`; see the Render guide for the per-operation field reference.

layerId.description: Target layer ID (`c{comp}:l{layer}:layer`). Used by all operations except `trim_comp`.

refLayerId.description: Reference layer for `shift_inpoint`, `shift_outpoint`, `trim_inpoint`, and `trim_outpoint` (its in/out time, selected by `refInOut`, anchors the move) and for `stretch_layer` (its duration becomes the target duration when no `duration*` field is provided).

refInOut.description: Which end of `refLayerId` to read as the reference time.

startLayerId.description: For `trim_comp`, the layer whose in point sets the start of the comp.

endLayerId.description: For `trim_comp`, the layer whose out point sets the end of the comp.

startSeconds.description: For `trim_comp`, the absolute start time of the comp, in seconds.

startFrames.description: For `trim_comp`, the absolute start time of the comp, in frames.

offsetSeconds.description: Offset added to the resolved reference time (`shift_*`, `trim_*`) or target duration (`stretch_layer`), in seconds. Takes precedence over `offsetFrames`.

offsetFrames.description: Offset added to the resolved reference time (`shift_*`, `trim_*`) or target duration (`stretch_layer`), in frames. Used only when `offsetSeconds` is absent.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds for `set_layer_duration` and `stretch_layer`, or the comp duration for `trim_comp`. Takes precedence over `durationFrames`.

durationFrames.description: Duration in frames for `set_layer_duration` and `stretch_layer`, or the comp duration for `trim_comp`. Used only when `durationSeconds` is absent.

durationPercent.description: For `stretch_layer`, the target duration as a percentage of the layer's native duration. Highest priority of the `stretch_layer` duration inputs: `durationPercent` > `durationSeconds` > `durationFrames` > `refLayerId`.

videoEnabled.description: For `enable_layer`, turns the target layer's video (visuals) on or off. Optional; each `enable_layer` operation must set at least one of `videoEnabled`, `audioEnabled`, or `solo`.

audioEnabled.description: For `enable_layer`, turns the target layer's audio on or off. Optional; each `enable_layer` operation must set at least one of `videoEnabled`, `audioEnabled`, or `solo`.

solo.description: For `enable_layer`, solos the target layer within its comp; only solo-enabled layers will render. A comp with solo-enabled layers will render against transparency or the comp's background color setting, depending on the render output format. To render audio-only to a video output format, solo an invisible video layer (such as a null) in addition to any solo-enabled audio layers; this is not necessary when rendering to an audio output format. Optional; each `enable_layer` operation must set at least one of `videoEnabled`, `audioEnabled`, or `solo`. If `videoEnabled` and `audioEnabled` are both false for a layer, solo cannot be applied to it.

outputs.description: Defines which variation and preset combinations to render and optional output file names.

variationIndex.description: Zero-based index of the variation to render.

presetIndex.description: Zero-based index of the preset in the presets array.

fileName.description: Optional custom file name for the output.

destination.description: A pre-signed URL destination for the video output.

name: cancel-render-job
description:
Aborts an in-flight render job. Returns `202 Accepted` as soon as the cancellation has been accepted; subsequent calls to `GET /v1/status/{jobId}` will report `"status": "canceled"` once the worker has fully stopped the underlying render.

**Applicable only to render jobs submitted via `POST /v1/templates/render`.** This endpoint does not apply to Describe, Reframe, TLS, TTS, or Avatar jobs.

**Notes:**
- Cancellation is idempotent.
- Once propagated to the worker, in-progress outputs are not uploaded to the destinations specified in the original render request.
- For a short window after the PUT, the status endpoint may still report `running`; poll until it transitions to `canceled`.

jobId.description: UUID of the render job to cancel, as returned in the `jobId` field of the original 202 submit response or in the `cancelUrl` property of a List Render Jobs response item.

x-request-id.description: GUID, unique per request. Auto-generated if not provided.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: UUID of the render job to cancel, as returned in the `jobId` field of the original 202 submit response or in the `cancelUrl` property of a List Render Jobs response item.

parameters.name: x-request-id
parameters.description: GUID, unique per request. Auto-generated if not provided.

name: list-render-jobs
description:
Returns a paginated list of template render jobs owned by the authenticated caller, optionally filtered by status and creation date.

**Applicable only to render jobs submitted via `POST /v1/templates/render`.** Jobs from other API types (Describe, Reframe, TLS, TTS, Avatar) are not returned.

**Filter syntax (FIQL):**
- `status==running` — single status equality
- `status=in=(running,not_started)` — status set membership
- `createdDate=ge=2026-05-01T00:00:00Z` — absolute ISO 8601 lower bound
- `createdDate=ge=-P7D` — relative ISO 8601 duration (last 7 days)
- Combine with `;` (AND): `status==running;createdDate=ge=-P7D`

**Default filter:** all statuses, `createdDate` within the last 30 days.

**Retention:** `createdDate` filter values must fall within the 30-day retention window.

**Pagination:** follow `paging.nextUrl` until it is absent (last page).

filter.description: FIQL filter string. Supported sub-params: `status` (enum) and `createdDate` (ISO 8601 date-time or relative duration). Default: `createdDate=ge=-P30D;status=in=(not_started,running,succeeded,partially_succeeded,failed,canceled)`.

limit.description: Maximum number of job entries to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100 (inclusive). Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned in `paging.nextUrl` of a previous response. Omit to fetch the first page.

x-request-id.description: GUID, unique per request. Auto-generated if not provided.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: FIQL filter string. Supported sub-params: `status` (enum) and `createdDate` (ISO 8601 date-time or relative duration). Default: `createdDate=ge=-P30D;status=in=(not_started,running,succeeded,partially_succeeded,failed,canceled)`.

parameters.description: Maximum number of job entries to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100 (inclusive). Defaults to 20.
